newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair adds new U.S. codeshare cities.
newsitem.headline: Swissair adds new U.S. codeshare cities.

text.p: Swissair said it would offer eight new destinations in the United States from June 1 as part of an increase in the number of connections offered over the North Atlantic by the four partners in the Atlantic Excellence partnership.

Swissair, the main airline in the SAirGroup, said the new destinations would increase the number of U.S. cities served by Swissair to 26 and will be operated on a codeshare basis with Delta Air Lines.
The new Swissair destinations are: New Orleans, Charlotte, Fort Lauderdale, Portland, Memphis, Nashville, Phoenix and Tallahassee, Swissair said in a statement.
The cities will be served from Zurich via the Delta hubs of Cincinnati and Atlanta.
Delta passengers from the U.S. will also be offered seven new European codeshare destinations via Zurich.
In addition to Swissair and Delta, the Atlantic Excellence includes Austrian Airlines and Sabena.
AUA and Sabena also plan to increase the number of Atlantic Excellence codeshare destinations in the U.S.
